description_en: Updates multiple accelerated domain names at a time
description_zh: 调用BatchUpdateCdnDomain批量更新加速域名基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun cdn batch-update-cdn-domain --domain-name example.com,example.org --sources content_:_10.10.10.10_,_type_:_ipaddr_,_priority_:_20_,_port_:80,_weight_:_15 --resource-group-id rg-acfmyuji4b6r400 --top-level-domain example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUpdateCdnDomain

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain names. You can specify one or more accelerated domain names. Separate domain names with commas (,).

parameters.description_en:
The information about the addresses of origin servers.

> Do not set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time. If you set **Sources** and **TopLevelDomain** at the same time, **TopLevelDomain** does not take effect.

> 不支持同时传入**Sources**和**TopLevelDomain**参数，如果您同时传入**Sources**和**TopLevelDomain**参数，**TopLevelDomain**将不生效。
